updates.name: Michelle McClure
updates.bio: Fourth director of NOAA's Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory, in the post since February 2019. Before that she spent two decades in research and leadership at NOAA Fisheries, working on the science behind sustainable fisheries and protected resources. She studied ecology at Evergreen State College and earned a PhD in ecology and evolutionary biology at Cornell.
updates.research_interests: fisheries science for sustainable fisheries; protected resources
updates.evidence: Dr. Michelle M. McClure PMEL Director
updates.notes: Old homepage (about-pmel/organization) is the org page; www.pmel.noaa.gov/people/dr-michelle-m-mcclure 301-redirects to an internal host, so the profile at /about-us/people/dr-michelle-m-mcclure (200) is used. The profile shows ORCID 0000-0003-4791-8719 (matches the lake); pub.orcid.org record: name Michelle McClure, employment NOAA PMEL, Director, 2019-present. No Google Scholar link on the profile. Verifier: status source moved from the organization page (which only links the word 'Director' to her profile) to the profile, which names her as PMEL Director.

updates.name: Galen Erickson
updates.bio: Holds the Nebraska Cattle Industry professorship in animal science at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, where he is also extension beef feedlot specialist and, since 2022, director of the Beef Innovation Hub. His cattle nutrition research covers byproduct, grain and silage feeds, links between feeding, management, air quality and nutrients, and greenhouse gas and enteric methane from beef systems.
updates.research_interests: beef cattle nutrition; byproduct feeds for growing and finishing cattle; grain and silage use; nutrition, management and environment (air quality, nutrient management); greenhouse gas flux and enteric methane reduction in beef systems
updates.current_title: Nebraska Cattle Industry Professor of Animal Science; Beef Feedlot Extension Specialist; Director, Beef Innovation Hub
updates.current_affiliation: Department of Animal Science, University of Nebraska-Lincoln
